question: In a certain code language, ‘MONKEY’ is coded as ‘BHNQRP’ and ‘NAP’ is coded as ‘SDQ’. What is the code for ‘JUTEBAG’ in the given code language?
solution:
The logic followed here is:

&
lt;p>‘MONKEY’ is coded as ‘BHNQRP’ 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f7855ff933c4722ec5ff96bd363dd6d41d933050031037c1efb4767aff240a2.png] 

‘NAP’ is coded as ‘SDQ’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e2e328bfb50854883fab899cb065ce25dc39e128a4f5b01aca8da2c0841888d0.png] 

Similarly,

‘JUTEBAG’ is coded as 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/59ed214b1c36d498806c10e5baf412ad6c47c657744c9ef969d4c9f68f60db09.png] 

Thus, ‘JUTEBAG’ is coded as JDEHWXM.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1".**
